note: v4 (aquatic Marisa redesign): the braid no longer lifts, carries or turns anything and the parent no longer leans; root_pitch_degrees is 0 so the braid_rescue_* clips keep no whole-body tilt and root_lift is 0. The grip becomes a mouth bite (project original, not canon): mouth_root is the standard adult face_mouth front centre pushed mouth_forward_units in front of the face plane (the same anchor as living.json), and mouth_reach is the contact distance in blocks for an adult (scale with body size). Phase ticks for the new BraidRescue flow are approach, offer, bite, push, slide, settle, release; the old reach, contact, grip, lift, place and root_blend ticks stay so old readers resolve. The two braid segments keep their natural lengths and only pose a light visual touch on the rim or hold the paddle. boarding_body_bounds now covers pitch -18..+6 (index pitch+18) and roll -3..3 (index roll+3).

reach_lean.lore: Project original (not canon), 2026-10-18 v5: to touch an infant floating low beside the hull, the parent sinks her weight toward her braid side: roll -10 (the right, braid side down), pitch -5, squash h .84 w 1.06 d 1.05, a .6 unit shift toward that side and the lift (reach_lean_lift, exported) that keeps her lowest body point on the floor, eased in over ease_ticks from REACH and out over the same ticks in SETTLE. Whole-body tilt stays within 12 degrees (here about 11.2). The server's braid root uses this same pose (pivot = root bone, composed shift + Rz*Ry*Rx*S like the client); clip braid_reach_low plays it. The braid segments keep their natural lengths.
